t: You're looking at St George the Martyr, a Grade II* listed church on Borough High Street, at the junction with Long Lane, Marshalsea Road and Tabard Street. It sits in the historic Borough district of Southwark and takes its name from Saint George, the early Christian martyr who was a Roman soldier and refused to renounce his faith. Edward Cocker, an engraver who also taught calligraphy and arithmetic, is buried here. So is Whitley Heald, a Church of England vicar.
